units.source_text: 红叶节过后，我便回家，不久又到热海去了。

en.t: After the autumn leaves festival was over, I went home, and before long I went to Atami again.

units.source_text: 我一再叮嘱妻子，倘若野野宫将遗容照片送到镰仓家里，务必差人送到聚乐旅馆来，决不要擅自看这张照片，也不要让别人看。

en.t: I repeatedly told my wife that if Nonomiya sent the posthumous portrait photograph to our house in Kamakura, she must have someone bring it to the Juraku Inn, and that she must never look at the photograph on her own or let anyone else see it.

units.source_text: 因为这张照片是我这个外行人拍摄的，

en.t: Because this photograph had been taken by me, an amateur,

units.source_text: 倘使把名人的遗容拍得很丑陋或者很凄怆，再让别人看见后张扬出去，会有损名人的威望。

en.t: if I had photographed the master's remains in an ugly or pitiful way, and others saw it and spread the word, it would damage the master's dignity.

units.source_text: 如果照片拍得不好，我也不让名人的遗孀和弟子们看，打算把它付诸一炬。

en.t: If the photograph had turned out badly, I intended not to show it even to the master's widow or his disciples, but to burn it instead.

units.source_text: 我的照相机快门出了毛病，也许就没拍好。

en.t: The shutter on my camera was malfunctioning, so perhaps the picture had not come out well.
